title: Summit Club Members: Lounge Miles on Summit Retro Credits
content:
A Crestline Summit Loyalty Program retro credit carries lounge miles according to the member's Summit Club membership under the Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships charter, as that membership's product and status show on its record.

**Rule.** An active Summit Club Executive, Summit Club Corporate or Summit Club Lifetime membership adds 1 mile per US dollar of the credited segment's eligible fare. An active Summit Club Essential, Summit Club Individual or Summit Club Individual Plus membership adds 0.5 miles per US dollar of eligible fare. Each is rounded down to the whole mile. A member with no active Summit Club membership adds no lounge miles. The lounge miles are computed on the eligible fare and are added to the miles the credit carries.

| Summit Club membership on record | Status | Lounge miles per USD of eligible fare |
|---|---|---|
| Executive, Corporate or Lifetime | Active | 1 |
| Essential, Individual or Individual Plus | Active | 0.5 |
| Any product | Not active | None |
| None held | | None |

**Points of judgement**

- Both the product and the active status are needed; an Executive membership that is not active adds nothing.
- Hypothetical figures: on an eligible fare of 318.70 USD, an active Executive membership adds 318 miles and an active Individual membership adds 159 miles (from 159.35).
